InstitutionalDepartmentName: Department of Computer Science, Machine Learning Group
TaskDescription: Left vs right hand motor imagery (kinesthetic imagery of opening and closing hands). Trial duration: 10.0s, cue: 2.0s.
Instructions: Perform kinesthetic motor imagery of opening and closing the left or right hand according to the visual arrow cue for 10 s, followed by a 15-17 s rest period.

Resampling.Description: The paper reports acquisition at 12.5 Hz; the distributed BBCI files (cnt.fs) are sampled at 10 Hz. No processing was added here.
